verdict.rationale: Linear is a SaaS product, so a published uptime SLA and a public status page are fair questions to ask, but the evidence pack documents neither. The 'monitor SLAs' mention describes agents users can build, not Linear's own uptime commitment, and the community DDoS remark does not show any status page.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know the vendor's published uptime SLA and can check real-time incident status via a public status page
